source.repin_rationale: RE-PINNED 2026-08-25 (open-offer carry). The gate IS the result envelope on this lane - neither central-exchange nor validator executed - so `require_specific` with a non-empty `compatible_entities` makes this a disambiguation PICKER turn, and a picker the customer has been shown now persists in its own `picker_*` fields: the next bare number resolves against the roster instead of against whatever the following answer leaves in `last_result_set` (captain 2026-08-20, execs 13212372 / 13212407 / 13212465). This fixture froze the output from before any `picker_*` key existed, so it was red for a FEATURE it predates, not for a defect. The kind is 'disambiguation', the only kind ever born into this carry: the CS member offer and the tier ask are excluded on purpose, because `selection_context: 'member_offer'` re-arms the parser's assign path and would fire a real CS assignment - staff email and WhatsApp - for a customer who had already declined. `last_result_set` and `selection_context` are unchanged, because the re-seat writes back the same roster the disambiguation lane had already produced. The set is also now born through `_isDisambig` (getResultObj's precedence chain) rather than off $('disallowed-entity-gate') directly, which is what `hand-validator-envelope-beats-gate` pins; on this lane both agree, which is why only the picker keys move.
